'''Introductory Two-Player Game''' is the eighth expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 1 January 1997. The set consists of 29 new cards.

The two-player game is available in two distinct editions (Edition #1 - blue '''Federation''' box and Edition #2 - red '''Klingon''' box). Each and every game set contains two pre-constructed 60-card decks, one Federation and one Klingon (both of which contain white-bordered cards), a black-bordered Data Laughing, a black-bordered Admiral McCoy, and a white-bordered Spock card. Each Federation deck includes the same 3 premium cards (a black-bordered Admiral Picard, a black-bordered Commander Troi, and a black-bordered Commander Data) and 11 new white-bordered mission cards. Each Klingon deck includes the same 3 premium cards (a black-bordered Gi'ral, a black-bordered Ja'rod, and a black-bordered Mogh) and 11 new white-bordered mission cards. Each box also includes one [[Premiere Unlimited '95]] expansion pack and one [[Alternate Universe]] expansion pack, a two page information sheet and a twenty page Quick Start Rules and Collector's List booklist.

==Trivia==
*The card [[Spock (I2PG)|Spock]] was only inserted in the first 500,000 boxes and was never officially reprinted with a black border in any future Decipher set. This is also the only instance of Spock to appear without an AU icon.
*As Mogh never appeared in any episode, the image on the personnel card is a composite image of Worf and Kurn.
*As Ja'rad never appears in any episode, the image on the personnel card is a composite image of Duras, Lursa, and B'Etor.
*The expansion set introduced the Barash icon, which would not be fully utilized until the release of [[Holodeck Adventures]].
*Admiral McCoy is the only instance of of any McCoy personnel card to appear without an AU icon.
*The mission Gault is missing the copyright line; instead it just reads: '''Z'''
*The card [[Sensitive Search (WP)|Sensitive Search]] is not part of the 29 Card release. It is an extra from the [[Warp Pack (expansion)|Warp Pack]] release.

==Federation box contents==
*3 Exclusive cards (''Admiral McCoy, Spock, Data Laughing''} + 3 Premium cards (''Admiral Picard, Commander Data, Commander Troi'')
*12 'New' cards
*8 reprint cards (from Alternate Universe and Premiere Unlimited)
*1 Variant
*2 Preconstructed decks (1 Federation, 1 Klingon)
*1 Rulebook

==Klingon box contents==
*3 Exclusive cards (''Admiral McCoy, Spock, Data Laughing''} + 3 Premium cards (''Mogh, Ja'rad, Gi'ral'')
*12 'New' cards
*8 reprint cards (from Alternate Universe and Premiere Unlimited)
*1 Variant
*2 Preconstructed decks (1 Federation, 1 Klingon)
*1 Rulebook

==Additional Information==
*Printed on 121 card sheets by Carta Mundi, Belgium on Superlux card stock.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
